t: Men's Rebel by Durango Desert Camo Pull-On Western Boots (DDB0166)
d:
Details 
 This is the men's 12" western Dusty Brown/Desert Camo Rebel. This style has a full-grain leather vamp, fox, collar and pull straps with a 900-denier nylon desert camo shaft. A cool new feature that was added to this style is a removable brass bottle opener located in the pull-tab. Inside the boot is a soft mesh lining and the Durango® X-Pand System™ which is a hidden gore expansion on the inside medial seam for a universal fit and easy on/off.
 This style also has the Durango X-Treme Comfort Memory Foam footbed which provides all day comfort and support along with a cushion flex insole. This style has a fiberglass shank, rolled shank area and a lightweight and flexible molded EVA midsole. The outsole is slip and oil resistant, dual-density and abrasion resistant rubber with a double row sole stitch around the square toe for added durability and a 1 ½" rocker heel.
- Square toe
- EVA midsole
- Cushion Flex insole
- Rolled shank area
- Fiberglass shank
- Soft mesh lining
- Removable metal bottle opener in pull-tab
- Double row sole stitch
- Full-grain leather foot, collar and pull straps with 900 denier nylon shaft
